note: Roadmap built from the official trophy descriptions: story chapters and missions first, then stranger strands, then activities and collectibles, then the long grinds and 100% completion. Trophy ids refer to app/data/trophies.json.

stages.goal: Play the story start to finish and let the counters build underneath you.
stages.tip: Do the missable partner and scene trophies when they come up — see the Missables section below. Stunts, choices and spending all count while you play, so do not grind them yet.
stages.title: Stage 1 — Story (Chapters 1–4 + finale)

stages.goal: Finish every stranger chain to its last mission.
stages.tip: Stranger markers appear as you explore. Return to a strand whenever its marker shows — a chain only counts when its final mission ends, so never leave one half done.
stages.title: Stage 2 — Strangers & side characters

stages.goal: Clear the activities one type at a time, easiest first.
stages.tip: Gold the shooting range early while your aim is fresh. Races and drone races are easier with the fastest vehicles you own, and challenges tick over on their own.
stages.title: Stage 3 — Activities & challenges

stages.goal: Drive everywhere and finish the collections.
stages.tip: Combine this stage with the meditation spots and the WAiNK It photo spots — all three reward the same road trip across Leonida, and the 52-area map fills in as you go.
stages.title: Stage 4 — Collectibles & exploration

stages.goal: Robberies, laundering and the big counters, then 100%.
stages.tip: Save the 250 stunts and the $250,000 laundering for last — they finish themselves if you play the rest of the game first. 100% completion is the final gold; the platinum pops with it.
stages.title: Stage 5 — Cleanup & platinum
